resources.string: The Flatpak version runs sealed off from your browsers, so it cannot open Google's sign-in window. Paste your YouTube session cookies below instead, or use the .deb or AppImage version, which sign in directly.

In a browser signed in to Google, open music.youtube.com and the developer tools (F12). In Network, reload the page, pick a request to music.youtube.com and copy its Cookie request header. They act as your signed-in session and stay on this computer; a secondary Google account is safest.
No Google session found in that text (SAPISID is missing). Copy the whole Cookie header from a signed-in music.youtube.com request.
